import os

def get_health():
    return {"ok": True}


ROUTES = {
    "/health": get_health,
    # --- new routes go above this line ---
}


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

        body = json.dumps(fn()).encode()

        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
